faqs.title: What is a Popcorn Tile?
faqs.body:
• Popcorn is a special tile type unlocked at level 1111.
  • The goal is to create popcorn by merging tiles next to the popcorn machine and then collect all the popcorn boxes.
  • The popcorn machine displays the number of tiles required to create the popcorn.
  • Once the required number of tiles is merged, the popcorn machine disappears and 3 random popcorn boxes are placed on the board.
  • You can merge tiles anywhere on the board to create the popcorn.
  • After the popcorn is created, merge next to a popcorn box to collect it.

faqs.title: What are Mole Tiles?
faqs.body:
Mole is a special tile type unlocked at level 963.

  • The goal is to collect all the moles from mole hills on the board.
  • A mole can pop out of any mole hill.
  • Merge a stack next to a mole hill to collect the mole.
  • You can merge next to any part of a mole hill to collect it.
  • Each mole hill contains one mole that must be collected to clear it.

faqs.title: What are Locked Slots?
faqs.body:
• You will have to merge hex tiles to free up these slots.
  • Once you have reached the required score goal the lock slot will be free.

faqs.title: What is a Jelly Tile?
faqs.body:
Jelly is a special tile type unlocked at level 611.

  • To clear Jelly, you need to merge stacks adjacent to it.
  • Each Jelly tile can have 1, 2, or 3 slices.
  • To collect a Jelly slice, merge a stack next to a slice.
  • Once all the slices are collect the jelly would disappear from the board

faqs.title: What is a Seed Box?
faqs.body:
The Seed box is a special tile type unlocked at level 661.

  • Its purpose is to create and collect all the grass on the board.
  • Each Seed box contains a specific number of seed packets.
  • When you merge a stack adjacent to a Seed box, it opens a seed packet, planting seeds onto a random tile.
  • The seeds turn the selected tile into grass, and the tile is chosen randomly.

faqs.title: What are Playpen tiles?
faqs.body:
• Playpen is a special tile type that are unlocked at level 241
  • The goal is to collect all the balls from the playpen; once all balls are collected, the playpen tile is removed, freeing up a tile space.
  • To clear a ball from the playpen, you need to merge tiles of the same color as the ball next to the playpen tile, which will clear the balls and eventually the playpen.

faqs.title: What is a Car Tile?
faqs.body:
A Car tile is a special type of tile that is unlocked after level 181.

  • A car tile is a dynamic tile requiring you to clear all tiles in its path for it to get to the end of the board on the side it is facing.
  • You do not need to merge a stack to clear a car tile, just need to clear its way for it to move.
  • Every time a tile is cleared of a stack the car moves and occupies the next available position in the Stack.

• Pearl is a special tile type unlocked at level 391.

  • Each pearl in a level can have a different color.
  • Once all the pearls are collected, the clamshells close.

• Bird's Nest is a special tile type unlocked at level 421.

faqs.title: What is a Drone Tile?
faqs.body:
• Drone is a special tile type unlocked at level 451.
  • The objective of a drone tile is to initiate a drop that adds new tiles to the board.
  • When a stack is merged next to a drone, its propellers begin spinning.
  • On the next merge, the drone takes flight and drops a tile onto the board.
  • Once all its tiles are dropped and collected, the drone itself will be collected.

faqs.title: What is a Doll Tile?
faqs.body:
• Dolls are a special tile type that unlocks at level 481.
  • The objective of dolls is to collect the smallest doll.
  • A doll tile has three levels, meaning you need to merge three stacks next to the doll to fully collect it.
  • Every time a stack is merged, the doll opens to reveal a smaller doll inside. This new doll bounces to a random neighbouring tile.

faqs.title: What is a Rainbow Launcher?
faqs.body:
• Rainbow Launcher is a special tile type unlocked at level 511.
    - The goal of the Rainbow Launcher is to activate it and have it merge with a random stack to clear it.
    - The Rainbow Launcher acts as a helpful assistant during gameplay.
    - To activate the Rainbow Launcher, merge a stack next to it.
    - Once activated, the Rainbow Launcher will launch a rainbow when you merge next to it. The rainbow will land on a random stack, helping you clear it.

faqs.title: What is a Color Nuts Tile?
faqs.body:
- Color Nuts is a special tile type unlocked at level 561.
- You have to merge same-colored stacks next to the Color Nuts Tile to collect the nuts and achieve your goal.
- Each Color Nut Bolt contains several different colored nuts.
- To clear a bolt, you must collect all the nuts associated with it.

Pro Tip: You can merge for the nut at the bottom to clear your color nuts in one single move!

faqs.title: What is a Cupboard Tile?
faqs.body:
• Cupboard is a special tile type unlocked at level 711.
  • Merge stacks next to the Cupboard to break it open and reveal the cups inside.
  • Once opened, merge next to the Cupboard again to break a cup.
  • You can merge next to any part of the Cupboard to break the cups.
  • Some Cupboard tiles can span multiple spaces on the board.
  • Each Cupboard contains a set number of cups that must be broken to clear it.

faqs.body:
• Safe is a special tile type unlocked at level 761.
  • Merge stacks next to the Safe to unlock it.
  • Each Safe requires 60 tiles to be merged next to it.
  • You can use multiple small stacks or fewer large stacks to reach the total.
  • Once 60 tiles are merged, the Safe will be collected.

faqs.body:
Bloom is a special tile type unlocked at level 861.

  • When you merge a stack next to a Bloom tile, it will sprout with the color of the merged stack.
  • To clear the Bloom tile, you need to merge a stack of the same color next to it.

faqs.title: What is a Toaster Tile?
faqs.body:
Toaster is a special tile type unlocked at level 911.

  • The goal is to collect toast pieces.
  • Merge a stack next to the Toaster to start it.
  • On your next merge, two toast pieces pop out and are collected
  • The Toaster keeps working until you collect the total number of toast pieces shown in the level goal, then it disappears.

faqs.title: What is a Kettle Tile?
faqs.body:
Kettle is a special tile type unlocked at level 961.

  • The goal is to clear smoke clouds.
  • Merge a stack next to the Kettle to release a smoke cloud that covers a random stack.
  • Merge next to the smoked stack to clear the smoke and free that tile.
  • The Kettle keeps releasing smoke until you clear the number of smoke clouds required by the level goal, then it disappears.

faqs.title: What is a Candy tile?
faqs.body:
• Candy is a special tile type unlocked at level 1153.
  • The objective is to collect candy by making merges next to the candy machine.
  • Each time you merge beside the machine, a candy is produced and collected. As the candy is consumed, the machine’s stick shortens, freeing up more space on the board.
  • When the stick is completely used up, the candy machine disappears.

faqs.title: What is a dice tile?
faqs.body:
• Dice is a special tile type unlocked at level 1253
  • Merge stacks next to the Dice to roll it
  • Collect the number shown on the Dice when it rolls
  • Once the required numbers are collected, the Dice will disappear from the board

faqs.title: What is a Drill Tile>
faqs.body:
• Drill is a special tile type unlocked at level 1353.
  • The goal is to use the Drill to collect tiles from the board.
  • Merge a stack next to the Drill to activate it.
  • On the next merge, the Drill will travel to the nearest tile and collect it.
  • If multiple tiles or objects are at the same distance, the Drill will choose one randomly.
  • The Drill remains on the board for the entire level.

faqs.title: What is a Soil tile?
faqs.body:
• Soil is a special tile type that is unlocked at level 1453.
  • The goal of the Soil tile is to clear all connected soil patches from the board.
  • To clear Soil, merge any stack next to a Soil tile.
  • When you break one Soil tile, all other Soil tiles directly connected to it will also break at the same time.
  • Soil tiles only clear in connected groups, so larger clusters of Soil will disappear together once any tile in that group is broken.

faqs.title: What is a Rabbit Tile?
faqs.body:
• The Rabbit is a special tile type unlocked at level 1602.
  • The goal of the Rabbit tile is to collect the carrot.
  • To wake up the Rabbit, merge stacks next to it.
  • Once the Rabbit is awakened, it will reveal a carrot.
  • Merging stacks next to the Rabbit will clear it once the carrot is collected.

faqs.title: What is a Penguin Tile?
faqs.body:
• The Penguin is a special tile type unlocked at level 1753.
  • The goal of the Penguin tile is to clear the path to the igloo, and by freeing the penguin from the ice
  • To melt the ice, merge stacks next to the Penguin.
  • Once the ice is melted, your penguin can move towards the igloo
  • You can move the penguin to the igloo by clearing the tiles in its way
  • The Penguin tile is cleared once the penguin reaches the igloo

faqs.title: What is a Tesla Tile?
faqs.body:
• Tesla is a special tile type unlocked at level 1903.
  • The goal of the Tesla tile is to charge it and light a bulb.
  • To charge the Tesla, merge stacks next to it.
  • After charging the Tesla, merge next to it again to light a bulb.
  • The Tesla tile is cleared once the required bulbs are lit.

faqs.title: What is the Hex Generator tile?
faqs.body:
• Hex Generator is a special tile type unlocked at level 2103.
  • The goal of the Hex Generator is to collect hexa tiles produced by the generator.
  • The Hex Generator releases a hexa tile into the slot directly in front of it.
  • To receive the next hexa tile, clear the slot in front of the Hex Generator by merging a stack on it.
  • Once the slot is cleared, the Hex Generator releases another hexa tile.
  • The Hex Generator keeps producing hexa tiles until the level goal is met.
